'Documents show that actions occurred', tour-card bounding box x=1336 (>1300 required) at 1920 width, BFA still visible and NOT covered. critical_code_review_comments:
pdf.js correctly uses createElement/createTextNode; setMultiline splits on \n and inserts document-created
elements — no innerHTML/document.write risk. Popup rendering verified to contain zero

TourCard useStepRunner uses lastRun ref keyed on idx (not on navigate identity) — this is the stale-closure fix; verified busy clears within a few hundred ms after each action step (steps 3,4,5,7,13,14 all reached ready state before advancing).
useAutoAdvance reads STORY[idx].dwell — climax step (idx 5, dwell 22000) empirically waited >15s before advancing (still 6/16 at 15s, advanced by 26s). Correct.

Glossary Term uses a fixed inset overlay <span> with onClick to close, and stops event propagation implicitly because popover span is absolute-positioned within the same parent — clicking a term inside the timeline detail does NOT toggle the parent event button. Verified by observing event remains expanded after popover open/close.

MatterTimeline default open state is lastConseq?.id — when testing, do NOT click the succession event first; it is already expanded. Otherwise the click will collapse and the Term will not be in the DOM.
PortfolioIntelligence panel present on /oversight with derived Officer/Matter/Process signals — matches iteration_5 semantics after golden path.
seed_data_creation: Ran Harrington golden path via /api/upload-source, /api/verify-claims, /api/create-changeset, /api/approve-changeset to seed a consequential event for /fiduciary/timeline glossary test. Cleaned up via POST /api/reset at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints are prefixed and named /api/upload-source, /api/verify-claims, /api/create-changeset, /api/approve-changeset (NOT /api/sources, /api/verify, /api/changeset). GET matter is /api/matter?matter_id=... (query param, not path). POST /api/reset requires JSON body {} or 403 via ingress. When testing MatterTimeline term-consequential-event, DO NOT click the event first — the last consequential event is expanded by default. For State Comparison / Checkpoint Scrubber, use the tab buttons on /fiduciary/timeline (button:has-text('State Comparison') and 'Checkpoint Scrubber'). Matter switching remains React context — after selecting a different matter, navigate via in-app sidebar text links ('Matter Timeline', 'R.A.C. & Evidence', etc.), not page.goto to a bare route while context is unset (may redirect to landing).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. The initially observed 'term-consequential-event not found' during testing was tester error (double-clicking the already-expanded event and thereby collapsing it), not a product bug. Retested without pre-click and the term/popover render correctly.
